ceo.name: Charles Guay
ceo.title: Chief Executive Officer (Président-directeur général)
ceo.entity: The Union Life Mutual Assurance Company (L'Union-Vie, compagnie mutuelle d'assurance), doing business as UV Insurance / UV Assurance
ceo.reports_to: Board of Directors (Chair Alain Bédard, ICD.D, FSA, FCIA)
ceo.prior: National Bank of Canada (head of investment funds division); President & CEO Standard Life Canada (to the Manulife acquisition); President & CEO Manulife Quebec and CEO of Manulife's Canadian group benefits and group retirement operations; founder of an executive strategy/governance consultancy; chair of SuccessFinder; director of Pomerleau and AGF Management
ceo.comp_source: Mutual; no proxy circular; compensation undisclosed
ceo.note: Succeeded Christian Mercier (CEO December 2016 to September 2026). industry_since null: the release says '25 years of experience in the Canadian financial services industry' (implies ~2001) but gives no start year.

cio.name: Pierre Parenteau
cio.title: Senior Vice President, Actuarial and Finance, and Appointed Actuary (FSA, FCAS, FCIA, CERA); most senior officer over finance, corporate actuarial and risk, under whom oversight of the external asset manager is presumed to sit
cio.entity: The Union Life Mutual Assurance Company (UV Insurance)
cio.prior: More than 30 years in insurance and financial services at appointment (firms not named in the release); Insurance Portal reports he previously worked with Rohit Thomas (now BMO Insurance CEO) at TD; succeeded Luc Pellerin at UV
cio.note: UV has no CIO or investment officer. The FY2025 annual report (Chair's message) states: 'In 2025, we issued a tender for the management of our assets and selected Sun Life Capital as the new manager of our various portfolios', i.e. the C$2.4bn general account is fully outsourced to SLC Management, with a board Investment Committee (President Fabienne Lacoste, CFA; Chair Marco Fillion; members Benoît Durocher, Lisa To) overseeing. Parenteau is named here as the accountable executive because the annual report's management chart groups Finance (Richard Dionne) and Risk (Eric Timmons) under 'Actuarial and Finance', and a 2026 UV job posting for VP Corporate Actuarial says that role reports to the 'PVP Actuariat et Finance'; no source explicitly says he oversees the SLC mandate (inferred). industry_since null: 'more than 30 years' at 2021 implies pre-1991 but no year is given.

notes: UV Insurance (The Union Life Mutual Assurance Company, Drummondville) has no entities page and no CIO: the C$2.4bn general account was moved to SLC Management (Sun Life Capital) after a 2025 tender under a board Investment Committee presided by Fabienne Lacoste, CFA.
